*: Human: +1% crit with any weapon. Night Elf: +10% crit for 15 sec. The sources are almost evenly split.
protection: Stoneform cuts physical damage by 10% and removes bleeds.

*: Blood Fury: +10% attack power for 15 sec. Before the Oct 26 racial changes every source put it first.
protection: Endurance gives +5% health, War Stomp stuns nearby enemies.

*: Ruthless boosts both strikes and spells, Will to Survive removes stuns.
protection: Stoneform and Artisan’s Precision: +1% hit chance.

*: On the Horde only Undead can be a Paladin. Cannibalize restores mana, Will of the Forsaken removes fear.
Human: +1% crit, and the pet inherits crit. Night Elf: Elune’s Light and Shadowmeld.
Orc: Blood Fury and Command (+5% pet damage). Troll: +5% damage against beasts.
Shadowmeld now drops threat in combat too, plus Elune’s Grace and Quickness.
Blood Fury: +10% attack power for 15 sec.
Every source picks it: Eureka! also boosts Power Word: Shield, Inquisitive Mind gives +5% mana.
The sources are split. Undead is stronger in PvP: Will of the Forsaken removes fear, sleep and charm.
On the Alliance only Dwarf can be a Shaman: Stoneform and Artisan’s Precision (+1% hit chance).
Blood Fury gives both attack power and spell power: good for Elemental and Enhancement alike.
restoration: For a healer a source recommends Troll: Berserking, +10% casting speed for 12 sec.

*: Eureka! for 8 sec, Inquisitive Mind: +5% mana, Escape Artist breaks roots.
Orc Mage is a new Forever combination: Blood Fury now gives spell power.
Gnome: Eureka! and Inquisitive Mind. Human: damage over time can crit, and Ruthless gives +1% crit.
Orc: Blood Fury gives spell power. Undead is picked more often for PvP.
Elune’s Grace: +10% crit for 15 sec, and Quickness.
Endurance: +5% health, War Stomp works in forms too.

warrior: A blacksmith dresses in plate and weapons, and many recipes are personal. An engineer gets the grenades and devices a warrior lacks.
paladin: Protection, Retribution: Engineering + Mining. Holy: Alchemy + Herbalism
Holy burns a lot of mana: you make your own potions, and the Mana Well in camp replaces Blessing of Wisdom.
hunter: A leatherworker makes their own leather and mail and Armor Kits. An engineer makes scopes and guns.
rogue: You make your own leather, and the Camp Tent gives rest. Engineering is the main profession for PvP.
priest: A tailor makes belts with spell power from level 10, an enchanter makes wands with spell power from level 5. Tailored items get disenchanted into materials.
shaman: A leatherworker makes spell power gear for Elemental and Restoration and gear for Enhancement. Raids and groups need potions.
mage: Tailoring + Enchanting; for PvP and big pulls Engineering + Mining
A tailor provides early spell power gear, and tailored items get disenchanted. An engineer’s grenades hold big groups of enemies in place.
warlock: A tailor’s Faction Banner gives Spirit for Life Tap. Alchemy means potions and gold.
druid: You gather herbs in Travel Form and drink potions in any form. Mana Well and Incense Candle help Balance and Restoration.
